name: TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd
summary: TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation and warehousing services in China. The company offers port loading and unloading storage, transportation logistics, bonded warehousing, port comprehensive services, and other related business types. It also provides bulk cargo transportation for ore, coal, steel, sand, gravel, and water slag.
